H1.title: Java worker va Python receiver khong cung hash contract; import->index bi chan
H1.resolution: Standardized canonical JSON serialization across Java and Python. In Python CatalogSyncManager.compute_hash, enforced compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace separators: json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')). In Java CatalogImportService.computeSha256(String input), parse JSON into Jackson Tree Model (JsonNode), recursively sort all ObjectNode field names alphabetically, and serialize compact UTF-8 bytes without whitespace. Verified 100% byte-for-byte SHA-256 match between worker and receiver.

H2.title: Request bi tu choi van thay catalog dang phuc vu; chua co candidate/publish atomic
H2.resolution: Refactored FastAPI sync_index to use the Candidate Manager Pattern. Built candidate CatalogSyncManager and verified declared content_hash before acquiring _publish_lock and before touching active global state. Verified candidate index build before mutating active references. Implemented Compare-And-Swap (CAS) with publish lock: stale generation (< current) returns SKIPPED; same generation with different content returns 409 Conflict without mutating state. Swapped references atomically only after successful candidate build. Persisted state to data/indices/catalog_sync_state.json with automatic startup restoration.

H3.title: Tua scene doi file timestamp thanh logical time lan nua; unknown bi doan thanh 0
H3.resolution: Strictly separated file timeline from logical timeline. In frontend/app/series/[id]/page.tsx: handleSeekScene seeks directly via scene.startMs / 1000 without passing through resolveFileTimestamp, guarding asset identity (scene.mediaAssetId === currentAssetId). Deep link handling for scenes seeks directly in seconds; segment deep links resolve logical coverage. Refactored resolveFileTimestamp to return number | null without coercing episode_in_ms=null to 0; unknown/unresolved offsets return null. In handleSeekSegment, if offset is unresolved (null), seek is disabled and user is alerted with a descriptive warning banner instead of jumping to 0s.

H4.title: Protected video chua co duong xac thuc tu browser; Drive containment van o ngoai deadline
H4.resolution: Implemented short-lived HMAC-SHA256 Playback Grants in Spring Boot security (JwtUtils.generatePlaybackGrant / validatePlaybackGrant, 5-minute TTL, bound to assetId and authenticated user role). Added authenticated endpoint POST /api/media/grant/{assetId} in MediaStreamController. Configured JwtAuthenticationFilter to inspect ?grant= query parameter on /api/media/stream/** requests, populating SecurityContext with granted authorities. Added frontend helper requestPlaybackGrant(assetId) and integrated in series/[id]/page.tsx. In StorageKeyConfig, bounded ancestor symlink traversal to non-Drive paths. In DriveMediaStorageAdapter, wrapped getResourceForPath and openChannelForPath metadata calls inside DriveIoExecutor executeMetadata.
tests: Spring Boot test suite (178/178 tests passed)

H5.title: Product acceptance van vuot pham vi evidence
H5.resolution: Conducted end-to-end multi-gate verification with concrete machine-generated artifacts. Ran complete Spring Boot test suite (178/178 passed). Ran complete FastAPI test suite (12/12 passed in 132s). Verified Next.js 15.1.2 production build and type check (0 errors). Executed independent repro probes CATALOG_01_F03_probe.py, CATALOG_01_F03_timestamp_probe.cjs, and comprehensive CATALOG_01_F04_probe.py. Verified contract invariance (5/5 files byte-identical). Validated reverse patch check (git apply --check -R docs/reports/CATALOG_01_F04.patch exited with 0). Produced structured manifest CATALOG_01_F04_MANIFEST.json with 112 file hashes.

P1_admin_import.details: Admin login -> Upload JSON dippie.catalog.v1 -> Dry-run preview with schema validation & diff counters -> Atomic 12-table import -> Scheduled worker syncs via HTTP to FastAPI with canonical SHA-256 hash -> Status badges update in real-time.

P2_player_playback.details: HTML5 player streaming video -> Browser authentication via short-lived playback grant token -> Strict asset identity guard -> File timeline scene seeking directly at startMs/1000 -> Logical segment seeking via coverage interval -> Graceful alert when offset is unresolved.

P3_search_retrieval.details: Multi-tier hybrid search across series, episodes, segments, and scenes -> Cascaded publication filter -> Deep links with distinct file/logical timeline params -> CineBot discovery grounded in verified catalog data.

P4_restart_stability.details: FastAPI sync state persisted on disk (data/indices/catalog_sync_state.json) and restored on startup -> Spring Boot orphan snapshot recovery on ApplicationReadyEvent -> Monotonic generation uniqueness preserved across restarts.
